newsitem.title: USA: Nathan's Famous partners with TCBY.
newsitem.headline: Nathan's Famous partners with TCBY.

text.p: Nathan's Famous Inc and TCBY Enterprises Inc said Monday they formed a co-branding partnership to development traditional and non-traditional captive markets.

The alliance would allow the inclusion of Nathan's Famous signature all-beef hot dogs, toppings and a variety of other menu items in certain "TCBY" Treats shops, as well as adding the "TCBY" Treats concept to selected Nathan's Famous Restaurants, the companies said.
